original_placeholder.description: The quickened flax of the earth was duck-weaved in a simple square pattern and hung up on pickets.

source_correction: Inherited static tile-0-13 is a catalogue placeholder. PaintedFence tent is assigned after inherited PaintedWall and is the actual connected tile family.

connections.required_states: isolated; four ends; two straights; four corners; four T junctions; crossing
connections.gate_scope: UsesGate is the native placement association, not an automatic shared paint group. Canvas has no PaintWith group. Do not add gate-neighbor flags absent source support. Preserve native gate art and state mechanics; gate is not a new ledger target.
connections.attached_items: Expose cardinal midpoint join/attachment anchors. Named-gate contact is a visual authoring proxy; wildcard PaintWith=* has source support in SingleTrack only. Unknown other item groups remain unknown.
connections.native_rules: Same exact blueprint joins. Nonempty PaintPart matches parts. Neighbor PaintWith=* joins SingleTrack. Equal PaintWith requires nonempty source group. MultiTrack wildcard check is guarded by nonempty source group. Preserve track-dependent behavior; do not repair it during art generation.

palette.preview: Native w (#98875f) and r (#a64a2e), separate semantic roles and one coverage

source_shape: One central thin picket with red cap. East/west hanging canvas panels have a red upper hem and lower outer red folded corner. North/south connectors are a narrow red edge-on strip with intermittent primary crossbars. Not a solid masonry checker block or a roof tent.

native_behavior.note: Do not import BrinestalkFence Flyover or AllowMissiles declarations; maintain native collision, exploration, damage and gate ownership.

donors.name: Camping Tent
donors.role: Cloth tension, simple folded surface and pole outline only. No roof, triangular tent silhouette or new tent mechanics.

donors.name: Vanilla Textures Expanded - Variations
donors.role: Hanging fabric and narrow edge-on pole convention. Do not copy ornamental swags, tassels or crossrod.

donors.name: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Architect
donors.role: Actual linked fence atlas/cap convention and readable borders only; native Qud connection rules and cloth identity remain authoritative.

authored_geometry: Thin complete hanging fabric with a squared central picket, upper hem, lower folded color region and subdued square weave. Hidden thickness, cloth tension and camera elevation are authored estimates. One common frame for all16 masks, no independently fitted bounds.

frame.camera: Fixed cardinal map view. Calibrate world axes/pixel aspect in Blender and retain projection receipt. Source N/S connector spans tile boundaries; only declared connected sides may touch or cross canvas.

evidence_required: explicit attachment anchors and named gate/unknown group limits
